instances.claim: This tells me that the work's value is continually redefined — three times, in the same register, with the same word root.
instances.why: Line 16 already closes the five-transformation list with 'continually redefined by decentralized consensus'; 17 then states 'indeterminate and continually redefined' and 18 states 'an ongoing process of redefinition', and all three sit at the level of the work's value in the abstract — none moves to the object, the viewer, or the form. Line 20 does move (form: 'a becoming'; participants: 'actions of its participants'), so it is argument rather than padding, which leaves 17 and 18 as the restatements; I would keep 18, since naming Chang's initiation turns the list into an act and sets up 19–20.
